thread:
maria: quick pulse check: duplicate golden assets across probers are getting out of hand. thoughts on catalog vs repo-local?

ajay: catalog wins for observability + single source of truth. but must be immutable IDs so telemetry stays stable.

linda: agree on ids. question: store full (input+expected) or just hashes/metadata? full payloads are heavier.

ken: rough numbers: avg sample ~10-15KB, ~1500 samples/model, ~300 models in active pool -> several TB raw; zstd/dedupe brings that down but still sizable.

bench-bot: usage stat: ~65% of probers reference the same 200-sample golds. only ~8 distinct sets cover most runs.

sara: tradeoffs
- catalog: easier rotation + one ACL surface, easier metric joins
- local: faster canaries, less infra dependency for offline CI

maria: hybrid option: canonical catalog (immutable id) + prober-local shadowing (with metadata + expiry). telemetry emits both ids when shadowed.

ajay: semantics: canonical_id required, override_id optional. override metadata should include owner, reason, and expires_at.

infra-bot: infra ready for signed urls + rate-limiting; CI runner caching needed to avoid hot S3 traffic.

devbot: CLI plan: `ri-gold pull --id ID` and `ri-gold shadow --id ID --expires 7d --reason "canary"` to register an override.

bench-bot: canonicalization: keep raw_input + tokenizer-normalized input + expected_hash. avoids false positives due to tokenization differences.

sara: rollout sketch: read-only catalog behind ff -> migrate top-8 sets -> enable shadowing -> 14-day metric comparison. success metrics: >70% dedupe drop, update latency <24h, no FP increase.

maria: action: ajay to draft API spec by Fri; ken to run dedupe sim; devbot open CLI PR; sara draft playbook. i'll coordinate. :thumbsup:

linda: also add a small ingest linter for tokenizer variant mismatches. low-effort, high ROI.

maria: noted, adding to backlog. thanks everyone.
